findings.contract: .agent/packets/GL3-AUDIT-A5B.md: API contract requires subsequent offset pages to echo the first-page token and reject changed cohorts
findings.evidence: The route compares cohort only if one was supplied, while offset is accepted independently. A request with offset>0 and no cohort_token therefore returns a page without stale-cohort verification. On a direct reload or restored URL with nonzero offset, the client has no prior opportunityPage token and makes precisely this request.
findings.impact: If records or ordering change between page reads, the server can silently return duplicate or omitted records, defeating the explicit offset-cohort guarantee.
findings.required_correction: Require a nonempty cohort_token whenever offset>0, compare it to the freshly computed token, and return an explicit validation/stale response when missing or changed. Make the client obtain a fresh first-page token before restoring a nonzero URL/Back offset, or reset to page zero explicitly. Add backend and browser regressions for missing token, changed cohort, and direct nonzero-offset reload/Back.
